first is shoes. ive been doing all my speedwork and couple harder longruns in zoomflys and everything else in novablasts. both feel good and i was originally going to wear the zoomflys but i plan on taking the marathon easy and thought it might make more sense to wear the novablasts.

second is how im going to carry hydration nutrition. i was originally gonna wear a vest with my water and goos in em but through training i fucking hated the vest. i have a fanny pack i can fit all my goos and 1 water flask instead of 2 and i could grab water/gatorade at hydration stations. pretty sure i am going to make this change cuz i dislike wearing the vest a lot. also when i wear the vest my heart rate goes up like 15 bpm, it doesnt feel like it so i think its just the watch but id like my hr to be as accurate as it can
